name: Relative Image Width
changes: Default image size can now be selected without Pro. A change, or the image-width property in the open note, shows how to get Pro, with a Sponsor on GitHub button. Nothing is saved and the images keep their size.
tip: Write a relative size as the last part of an image link, for example ![[photo.png|50%]] or ![[photo.png|20rem]]. A size in pixels works as before.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Relative Image Width is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for trusting it with your notes.
